description: In desktop Chrome 153 with WebNN enabled, ORT Web 1.29 WebNN EP fails InferenceSession.create for silero_vad_op18_ifless.onnx on npu/gpu/cpu with 'ERROR_CODE: 6, absl::container_internal::raw_hash_map<>::at' even though GetCapability claims 1 partition of 43 nodes. WASM works (0.5 ms p50, drift 1e-6). Whisper-tiny encoder works on WebNN in the same harness, so the harness is not the cause. Confirm on the Even Android WebView; try freeDimensionOverrides variations, casting the int64 'sr' scalar, an opset/export variant, or report upstream to onnxruntime.
title: Investigate Silero VAD WebNN session failure (absl raw_hash_map::at)
